metadata.description: GATE 2024 CS2 question bank. Cleaned text, structured options.

rendering.math: Use LaTeX delimiters for mathematical expressions where they improve clarity; use Unicode otherwise.
rendering.tables: Tabular data uses structured JSON headers and rows; schematic layouts may use LaTeX arrays.
rendering.code: Code and SQL snippets use fenced code blocks in question text and options.
rendering.figures: Question figures are source-cropped in questions.json; image options use answer assets and assets_for_options.

A processor uses a 32-bit instruction format and supports byte-addressable memory. Its ISA has 150 distinct instructions, divided equally into R-type and I-type instructions. Their formats are:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline\text{OPCODE} & \text{UNUSED} & \text{DST Register} & \text{SRC Register 1} & \text{SRC Register 2}\\\hline\end{array}$$

I-type:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline\text{OPCODE} & \text{DST Register} & \text{SRC Register} & \text{\# Immediate value/address}\\\hline\end{array}$$

One opcode bit distinguishes I-type from R-type; the remaining opcode bits encode the operation. The processor has 50 architectural registers, and all register fields have equal size.

Let X, Y, and Z be the number of bits used for the UNUSED field, OPCODE field, and immediate value/address field, respectively. What is $X + 2Y + Z$?
